design_contract.intro_page: Explain what the passport is, why to use it, how to record symptoms, and urgent-contact rule; do not duplicate a grading snapshot from the later pages.
design_contract.table_unit: One symptom-grading table per treatment agent active in that cycle.
design_contract.row_unit: A patient-experienced symptom, not an organ or system.
design_contract.language: Patient language with CTCAE v6-informed severity boundaries; formal CTCAE grade remains clinician-assigned.
design_contract.red_flags: Urgent red flags are shown outside the grading tables and should not be delayed while the patient decides on a grade.
design_contract.combination_sact: Repeat agent-specific tables on the same cycle page so attribution is visible even when symptoms overlap.
design_contract.continuity: Use the same symptom wording across the anatomy guide, portal and passport wherever possible.

sources.patient_terms: NCI PRO-CTCAE patient symptom terminology where applicable
sources.pembrolizumab: EMA/NCI safety information; table prioritises common patient-experienced effects and visible portal toxicities
sources.pemetrexed: EMA product information; common patient-experienced effects prioritised
sources.carboplatin: Current carboplatin SmPC; common patient-experienced effects prioritised
